in_marathi.name: Lenyansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord Shiva's grace
in_marathi.long_meaning: Lenyansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Lenyansh is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Len' (Lord Shiva) and 'Yansh' (grace). This name signifies receiving the divine grace and blessings of Lord Shiva, the god of destruction and regeneration.
